text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I let down the people who believed in me last time...
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Next time... Next time, I must showcase
a run worthy of a Satono Umamusume...
choice_data_list: ...Don't put too much pressure on your—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm really getting fired up!
I'm the type who burns brightest when backed into a corner!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely.
This is where... I show what I'm truly made of!
